Prioritized requirements using MoSCoW and FURPS; collaborated on BV, CP, DoR, and DoD for Agile sprint planning.
Participated in Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Reviews, and Retrospectives to ensure successful Agile delivery.

Trained and supervised a team of 8 QC analysts and managed complex alert reviews and QC escalations.

management and QC workflows.
Prioritized requirements using MoSCoW and managed the sprint backlog in JIRA with the Product Owner and Scrum Master.
Validated the end-to-end AML case lifecycle during UAT, ensuring compliance with regulatory and internal AML policies.
Supported QC case allocation and workload management to improve review efficiency and SLA adherence. • Provided quality feedback, resolved process gaps, and improved investigation accuracy while reducing rework.
